summary: chunter-cb 提交账户配置式 AA 的初稿 EIP。nerolation 提交并合并 EIP-7981，把访问列表成本计入 EIP-7623 下限，同日提交授权数据计入下限的 EIP。ACDC #173 定下 Glamsterdam 主网 6 至 8 月、公共测试网约 5 月；ePBS 若来不及可不随 Glamsterdam 上线。ethereum 介绍 Railgun。

items.title: EIP-7981：把访问列表成本计入 EIP-7623 下限公式
items.note: （nerolation）提交并合并：访问列表数据成本计入固有 gas，其 token 计入下限计算，防止绕过 EIP-7623 calldata 下限。
items.title_en: EIP-7981: add access list cost to the EIP-7623 floor formula
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted and merged: access list data cost joins intrinsic gas and its tokens join the floor calculation, preventing a bypass of EIP-7623 calldata floor pricing.

items.title: 新增 ERC：钱包调用 gas limit 覆盖能力
items.note: （ajhodges）提交：为 EIP-5792 增加 gasLimitOverride，让应用在 wallet_sendCalls 中为每个调用指定 gas limit。
items.title_en: Add ERC: Wallet Call Gas Limit Override Capability
items.note_en: (ajhodges), submitted: adds gasLimitOverride to EIP-5792 so apps can set per call gas limits in wallet_sendCalls.

items.title: ACDC #173
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #8：Glamsterdam 主网目标 6 至 8 月（以便一年两次升级），公共测试网约 5 月，devnet 开发约 4 月完成；epbs-devnet-0 目标 2 月底，ePBS 若未就绪可不随 Glamsterdam 上线；Hegotá 头号提案截止 2 月 4 日；blob-devnet-0 已上线，是 BPO3 的前提。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #8: Glamsterdam mainnet targets June to August to allow two upgrades a year, public testnets around May and devnets done around April; epbs-devnet-0 targets late February, with an option to ship Glamsterdam without ePBS; the Hegotá headliner deadline is February 4; blob-devnet-0 launched, a prerequisite for BPO3.

keywords_en: A first account configuration AA draft
EIP-7981 counts access lists in the calldata floor and merges
authorization data in the EIP-7623 floor
ACDC #173 targets Glamsterdam for June to August
a wallet gas limit override ERC
benjaminion joins the EF for fast finality
summary_en: chunter-cb submitted first drafts of an account configuration AA EIP. nerolation submitted and merged EIP-7981, counting access list cost in the EIP-7623 floor, and the same day submitted an EIP adding authorization data to the floor. ACDC #173 set Glamsterdam mainnet for June to August with public testnets around May, with an option to ship without ePBS if it is not ready. ethereum featured Railgun.
